selector-class-pattern.message: Use .sm-block__element--modifier, an is-/has- state class, or a documented WordPress/third-party class

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Hard-coded colours are banned (use var(--wp--preset--color--*) / var(--wp--custom--*)); physical directions are banned (use start/end) — this is the RTL strategy.

property-disallowed-list.message: Use logical properties: margin-inline-start/end, padding-inline-*, border-inline-*, inset-inline-*.
